scripts.build: npm run build:volar && npm run build:services && npm run build:muggle-string && npm run build:muggle-pug && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b
scripts.build:services: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b services/packages/css services/packages/emmet services/packages/html services/packages/json services/packages/pug services/packages/pug-beautify --noCheck
scripts.watch: npm run build:volar && npm run build:services && npm run build:muggle-string && npm run build:muggle-pug && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b -w
scripts.watch:ext: npm run build:ext && npm run watch
